title: Validate satellite Engram onboarding outcomes before central persistence
outcome: Central stores bounded Engram verification diagnostics with fixed local reason strings; malformed authenticated satellite outcomes become Unavailable without affecting TermAl verification.
acceptance: Central validates remote Engram summaries for the existing check-count, check-length and control-character limits and stores fixed local reasons selected by status.
Malformed satellite outcomes are recorded as Unavailable, and regression coverage confirms they never affect TermAl Verified or Active.
